Name: Parchment - Fishing Log
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50188/50188-1785869701-433848155.png[/img][/font]
[font=Arial]The Fishing Log is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49525]Parchment [/url]mod that adds an in-game fishing logbook. Search any fish (vanilla or modded) to see where it lives, what weather it needs and anything else required to catch it. Recent catches are also tracked automatically, as well as other fishing related stats. [/font]

[font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50188/50188-1785871385-1180834013.gif[/img][/font]



[font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50188/50188-1785869698-1552174045.png[/img][/font]
[font=Arial]The Fishing Log is given automatically after getting the Bamboo Rod from Willy. If you have already met Willy or if you have lost your logbook, you can get one for free from Willy's shop.[/font]

[font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50188/50188-1785871643-761344242.png[/img][/font]


[font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50188/50188-1785869698-146730473.png[/img][/font]
[font=Arial]Simply use the Fishing Log to open it up. If you prefer not to use an item to see the UI, simply assign a keybind in [b]config.json[/b].[/font]
[font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50188/50188-1785871933-1859067023.png[/img][/font]

[font=Arial]Up to five bookmarks can be added, allowing you to easily go to a specific fish's page.[/font]
[font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50188/50188-1785871798-51738104.png[/img][/font]

[font=Arial]You can use the search bar on the top-right when viewing the fish list or any fish's page.[/font]
[font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50188/50188-1785871933-920671722.png[/img][/font]

[font=Arial]The book also contains a settings page![/font]
[font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50188/50188-1785871965-1931877175.png[/img][/font]

[font=Arial]With every unique catch, a sticker of the fish will be added to your logbook's cover! Modded fish are automatically supported. [/font]
[font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50188/50188-1785871345-989857058.png[/img][/font]


[font=Arial]Source code is [url=https://github.com/Floogen/StardewSandbox/tree/parchment/fishing-logbook]available here[/url].[/font]

Manifest.Name: (Parchment) Fishing Logbook
Manifest.Description: A Parchment mod that adds a handy logbook which helps with all things fishing.
Manifest.Author: PeacefulEnd
